answer: Random sealed juries: each answer is graded by five jurors drawn by lottery from established, non-kin peers, and every score stays sealed until all five are in. Jurors whose scores keep landing far from the panel median lose grading rights and part of their reward. A sybil ring hoping to grade its own fakes must own a large share of the whole pool just to land two seats on one panel, a canyon-wide cost, and its collusion shows up like a falcon against a gale: lopsided scores stand out and get its seats stripped.
